pick_word.subtitle: Get Tom to confess! Don't feel sorry for him.

question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Which character do you want to see more of?

nodes.text: Spike does an axle stall on the other side!
He drops in again...
Builds up speed to go up the vert...
And pulls off a 900!
Spike rides back down...
Builds up more speed...
And finishes with a Ho-Ho on the lip!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I didn't mean to upstage Skazz... But it seemed pretty natural to follow with a handstand!
Spike starts with a wobbly axle stall on the other side...
Spike drops in again...
And tries to get some extra speed...
To pull off an okay 720...
He rides back down...
Kicks off to get a little more speed...
And finishes with a safe lip grind.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Man... I really second-guessed myself! I know I can do better!

nodes.speaker: Loudspeaker
nodes.text: Next skater! Skazz von Tooten! You have five minutes to get to the starting deck!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: See you later, sucker... And when I do, I'll be holding that trophy!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Man, I have never seen Skazz so aggro...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I wonder what happened to make him like that...
Spike watches Skazz get ready...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Whoa! He's wearing some space age crash suit or something! His helmet is even molded to look like his old red cap!
The whistle blows! Skazz drops in!
Skazz builds up speed...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: What?! He pulled off a 900 right from the start!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Yes! I rule!
Skazz rushes back into the waiting area.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Eat that, sucker!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: When did you learn how to do that?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: It's called talent, loser!

nodes.speaker: Loudspeaker
nodes.text: Next skater! Spike Chapman! You have five minutes to get to the starting deck!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: I won't bother wishing you luck, 'cause you're going to wipe out anyway!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I can't let that jerk get to me.
A few minutes later, Spike stands on the deck with his spiky-green helmet, pads, and board.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Just me, the board, and the half-pipe...
Spike drops in!
He kicks off to get some more speed...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: All right, dude. You want it that badly, it's yours.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: What? Really? You're wussing out?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: No way! I'm here to skate my best.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: If you win this thing, then you deserve it.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: But you should know that I'm going to make you sweat for every last flip, ollie, and turn.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: You think you're so cool, don't you?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: C'mon, Skazz. When I skate, it's just me, my board, and the concrete. When you skate you think it's you versus everyone else.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: What's the difference?!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: A world of difference, man. Now, I gotta get ready.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You suck, Skazz, so why should I be afraid of you?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Ha! You don't know what new, phat skillz I've picked up!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I hear a lot of talk, but I don't see much action.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Speaking of action, have you perfected your Inverted Air Slug?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I don't have to, 'cause my basics alone will kick your butt.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Ha! I knew you couldn't handle that trick!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Just to show you up, I'm going to pull it off!
Spike and Mallika reach the waiting area.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: All right, I have to get ready.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I'll be with the film crew. I'll try to visit in between events. Good luck!
Mallika waves and hurries off.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I'll see you later... With a trophy!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Not if I have anything to say about it!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: C'mon, Skazz. Don't be hating when we're skating.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Heh. Good line.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Dude, I worked as hard as you to get here...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: So why is everyone saying you're the next Ryan Shacker?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: It's not my fault that I'm awesome.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: After today, you'll be the poser, and I'll be the next pro skater.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Don't get in my face, Skazz. I just want to skate.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: I think today is the day you'll be giving me some respect!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: What is up with this moron?

nodes.prompt: What is up with this moron?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What is up with this moron?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: But life can pan out like that. Just some hard work and...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: My mom has been working hard her whole life, and now she's jumping from temp job to temp job.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: She hasn't been given a break for all her hard work.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Well, she has to stick with it...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I'm talking about twenty years here! And she doesn't make enough to support me or Chip!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Er... Sorry... I didn't realize things were that bad...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: It's not that bad... Forget it... Let's get to the games...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Except... It is `that` bad...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You don't have to be humble about it, Spike.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Oh, I'm not being humble or anything.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Look, my mom has been working hard ever since I was born.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Some days are good. Some are bad. There have been a couple times when we almost lost the house.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Oh! I'm sorry! I didn't know!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: No big. But I don't let all that bad stuff get to me. I don't mean that I pretend that everything's okay...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: But I don't think that I'm going to be given anything just because I'm good at skateboarding...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I skate because when I'm pulling a trick, nothing else matters. I'm focused and calm.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: That sounds almost zen.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You can't let the world in when you're skating. Otherwise you'll miss a good flip or grind.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Yeah, Nicole says that I overthink things...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Okay... No more talk about winning, prizes, trophies, and contracts.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Actually, it's kind of cool that you think I can pull it off.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: It's been a while since someone's said that to me.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Spike, you're an awesome guy... Er... Skater. I'm only telling you what I see.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You know... Maybe I've really got a shot at that prize money!

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chapman
nodes.text: Okay, Spike. Here we are.

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chapman
nodes.text: I'm sorry I won't be able to cheer you on.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Are you sure? I know you have that job interview today...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: But does it really matter? I mean, if I can get a corporate sponsorship, we'll have so much money that you'll never have to work again!

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chapman
nodes.text: We've discussed this already, Spike. You need to stay in school and focus on getting into college! I'll handle earning the money.

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chapman
nodes.text: Besides, what would I do if I didn't have to work? Sit on my butt all day? I'd balloon into a whale!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: No way, Mom! You're too pretty!

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chapman
nodes.text: Thanks, Chip. But flattery won't get you away from the babysitter!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Aww...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I think your babysitter's pretty hot, little bro. Put on those signature Chapman moves, and she'll be your girlfriend in no time.

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Yeah? You think I've got a shot?

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chapman
nodes.text: Spike! Chip! Both of you stop that!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Heh heh!
Soon enough, Spike's family drops him off at the skate park. He rushes across the parking lot and runs into...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Hi, Spike!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Mallika! I wasn't sure if you were going to make it today...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Are you kidding? You're going to need a friendly face cheering you on!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Heh... Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: How are you feeling? Nervous?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Well, I've been practicing a lot, and I feel good about my skills... But it's the little things I'm worried about!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: It's like, think about my skateboard, right? Whenever I skate in a tournament, I use my lucky red board.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: But now, these corporate guys from `Skate-Minds` want me to model their fancy blue skateboard during the event! If I do well, they might even become my sponsors!
nodes.text_bbcode: But now, these corporate guys from [color=#e23b3b][i]Skate-Minds[/i][/color] want me to model their fancy blue skateboard during the event! If I do well, they might even become my sponsors!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: And I mean, their board is probably way better, and my family needs the money... But it's my lucky red board, you know?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Spike, I have never met anyone as passionate about skating as you are. I'm sure you'll blow them away no matter `what` skateboard you use!
nodes.text_bbcode: Spike, I have never met anyone as passionate about skating as you are. I'm sure you'll blow them away no matter [color=#3b78e2][i]what[/i][/color] skateboard you use!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: If the crowd sees what I see in you, they'll love you.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Oh! I... Er... Didn't mean it like that...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Let's just hit the reset button on this conversation, okay?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Yes! How have you been doing?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I'm doing great! Get this... A few minutes ago, I ran into the doc crew for the FLEX-Games!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Dock crew? Like with ships?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Er... Documentaries. I'm meeting the director now. I think he's going to let me help shoot the event!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Maybe I'll be able to get a lot of action shots of you.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I'd be happy with not falling during a trick.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I think you'll do great! You might even get that sponsorship!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Honestly, I doubt it. That kind of thing doesn't happen to guys like me.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: People recognize talent, and you have it.

nodes.prompt: People recognize talent, and you have it.

options.label: It doesn't always work that way.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: People recognize talent, and you have it.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Okay, Mom. I'll be careful. I'll play it nice and safe, and just do my usual routine...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Aw, come on! That's loser talk! You're never going to win the prize money with that kind of attitude!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hey! What gives you the right to lecture me about loser attitudes?! You're the guy that couldn't even handle the pressure of a 2nd grade spelling bee!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: The word was 'Mississippi'! It would have broken any man!

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chapman
nodes.text: Boys! Stop fighting this instant!

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chapman
nodes.text: Chip, don't encourage your brother to do dangerous things! The prize money won't matter to either of us if Spike gets hurt!

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chapman
nodes.text: And Spike, Chip is right. There is virtually no one alive who can spell 'Mississippi' on command. You should apologize!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Sorry, Chip. It is a pretty tough word.

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: And I'm sorry too. You can do whatever trick you want... So long as you win!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Heh. I guess I'll just have to do my best!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Look, Mom, I have never managed to pull off my Inverted Air Slug. It feels like today's the day to do it.

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Awesome! You can do it, Spike!

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chapman
nodes.text: Spike, don't encourage your little brother like that! You will `not` be doing anything reckless today!
nodes.text_bbcode: Spike, don't encourage your little brother like that! You will [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] be doing anything reckless today!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: But, Mom, I'm doing it for the family! We need the money!

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chapman
nodes.text: You are such a sweet boy, Spike. But it's my job to make the money. It's your job to stay safe.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: All right, Mom. I'll play it safe.

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Aw...
Spike reaches up and discretely tugs on his earlobe!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Heh heh...
Chip does the same!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Heh... It's been a while since we've used our secret signal.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: This way Chip knows that I'll try to pull off my killer move, and Mom won't have to know.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Now I have to make sure I don't get hurt!
It's the day of the FLEX-Games, and Spike is on his way... With a great support team!
Spike's mom drives the car to the FLEX-Games with Spike sitting shotgun, and his younger brother Chip in the backseat.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Man, oh, man. I'm nervous. I know I've got the Half-Pipe event down... But I'm just not sure about the Street Course!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Don't worry, bro. Do an Inverted Air Slug and coast on that for the rest of the games!

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chapman
nodes.text: Chip Chapman, don't you encourage your brother to do something stupid!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Sorry, mom...

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chapman
nodes.text: No, I'm sorry, honey. I guess I'm worried that your brother will get hurt...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Yeah, whatever...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: C'mon, Mom. I've been skating for years.

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chapman
nodes.text: I don't want you to try these dangerous stunts. It's only a matter of time before your luck runs out.

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: It's not luck! Spike's a champion skateboarder! He can handle the Inverted Air Slug!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hmm... How do I play this?

nodes.prompt: Hmm... How do I play this?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Hmm... How do I play this?

nodes.speaker: Lors Von Tripe
nodes.text: Congratulations! Amazing! Astounding! You know so much about film, I nominate you to be the one who interviews the sponsors!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Really? That's great!

nodes.speaker: Lors Von Tripe
nodes.text: Wait... No... It was a punishment... I hate talking to those rich imbeciles!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: But it would be a great opportunity to do some investigative reporting.

nodes.speaker: Lors Von Tripe
nodes.text: Actually, I was thinking that they would spend all their time plugging their products...

nodes.speaker: Lors Von Tripe
nodes.text: But heck, if you want to do it, the job's yours. Let me get you a camera, tape, and the batteries!
Mallika heads out to the sponsors' section of the parking lot with her film equipment.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Wow!  I have so many questions to ask!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I want to know their views on the commercialization of skateboarding versus its origins as a street art.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I could ask them what sort of charitable organizations they support!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You're lying to me! You wouldn't go through all that trouble just to humiliate Spike!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: He humiliated me! This is payback!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: `I` humiliated you, Tom! And the worst you've done to me is try to keep me out of a concert!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] humiliated you, Tom! And the worst you've done to me is try to keep me out of a concert!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, he was there when you threw me in the water and did nothing to help!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: And `that's` why you're blowing thousands of dollars on Skazz? Even you're not that petty!
nodes.text_bbcode: And [color=#3b78e2][i]that's[/i][/color] why you're blowing thousands of dollars on Skazz? Even you're not that petty!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: What's your real issue, Tom?! `Why are you so obsessed with Spike?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What's your real issue, Tom?! [color=#3b78e2][i]Why are you so obsessed with Spike?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Because he stole you away from me!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Uh... I... I mean...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Come on, Tom... There's got to be more to this... You can tell me why you're `really` trying to ruin Spike...
nodes.text_bbcode: Come on, Tom... There's got to be more to this... You can tell me why you're [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] trying to ruin Spike...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I already told you. Now let's just move on... I grow weary of this prattle.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Tell me! Please, please, please! I'll be really nice, I promise!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hmm... I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Pleeeeeaaaaaasee? With a cherry on top?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Mmm... You are `so` attractive when you beg!
nodes.text_bbcode: Mmm... You are [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] attractive when you beg!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Ew! He was baiting me! Now I need to scour my skin with a cleanser!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Wait a second... You find me attractive?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Uh... Well, I... That is to say...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: About two months ago, I was investigating the Centerscore Skate Park for one my father's business ventures, when I ran into a pathetic jelly of a human being...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Argh! Come on! If Spike can pull off the Inverted Air Slug, so can I!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Excuse me, did you say 'Spike'? Is he a waiter with spiky green hair?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: You know that loser?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Know him? Er... Let's say he and I need to clear up a... Misunderstanding...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Well, get in line! I need to beat him at the FLEX-Games! After that, you can do whatever you want!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: FLEX-Games? Tell me more... Perhaps we can help each other...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I hired personal trainers, coaches, and nutritionists. He had two months of intense training to become a sportsman.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: In fact, he's more than a sportsman now. He's an athletic machine!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Why would you possibly want to train Skazz?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Would you believe that I'm a good samaritan? That I saw in Skazz a kindred soul?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I think that you've had a grudge against Spike ever since that night we stood up to you at the restaurant, and you're willing to break the rules to humiliate him!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hey, everything I have done has been above board! The training, the equipment... Heck, it's even legal to dose the little weasel up with energy drinks!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And those things are known to ramp up aggressive and violent tendencies! Who knew?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'm not going to say that Spike is about to get what's coming to him...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But when he's defeated by an over-caffeinated puppet, maybe he'll realize that he never should have messed with Tom Prince!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I wouldn't put it past Tom to do something stupid out of spite... But this seems like way too much effort just to get back at Spike!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: My intuition tells me there's more Tom's not telling me... But I'm going to have to lay it on thick to get it out of him!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Time to bring out the serious interrogation techniques!

rounds.subtitle: Get Tom to confess! Don't feel sorry for him.
Get Tom to confess! Don't feel sorry for him.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: All right. A good filmmaker gives human beings... Even rotten, horrible, awful human beings... A chance to explain themselves.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Excellent! I just opened a vintage bottle of 1960 sparkling soda from the Bourgogne region in France! Can I pour you a glass?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Er... No.  In fact, I'm going to stand next to this door.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But what about the fois gras?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I'm a vegetarian. And it's cruel to the ducks.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But tasty!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Seriously though, let me offer you an olive branch.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Literally, if you want. I can get on the phone and get you an olive branch from Italy in an hour. My people are standing by.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Um... Okay... Let's just stick to the interview.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: What's going on? Why is he being so... Nice? It's got to be some kind of a trick...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I want you to know that I have turned over a new leaf... I came to an epiphany about myself, and you of all people must know what happened.
Mallika steps forward and starts her camera.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Okay, Tom. You want me to believe there's a soul in there? Prove it.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Sorry, Tom. I don't negotiate with terrorists, and I'm pretty sure this qualifies.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Oh, cute. A witty one-liner. Let me guess... Now you're going to turn around and walk out, hoping that I'll change my mind and talk.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: N... No! I've, uh, got way better plans than that!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Like what?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Like... Like... Like...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Hmph! Forget this!
Mallika storms out!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yaaaaaaaaaaawn.
Mallika storms back in!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Did it work?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Nope. But I did have the most marvelous yawn...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: All right, you win. You want to lord some knowledge over me, Tom? Just go ahead and do it.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Now there's that pathetic tone I like to hear!

nodes.speaker: Lors Von Tripe
nodes.text: Ha! Just as I thought! You know nothing about the industry!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: But... I've done films... I know about lighting, sound, and all that stuff...

nodes.speaker: Lors Von Tripe
nodes.text: Posting videos on YooTube does not a filmmaker... Make...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Just because I don't know those technical terms doesn't mean I don't know what I'm doing!

nodes.speaker: Lors Von Tripe
nodes.text: You don't even know how to communicate in English! How many double negatives was that?

nodes.speaker: Lors Von Tripe
nodes.text: Argh! This is impossible! I can't work with any of you! Ack! Ack!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Forget it! I don't need your support! I'll take a camera, and I'll interview those sponsors myself!

nodes.speaker: Lors Von Tripe
nodes.text: Do it! I challenge you! And I will laugh with impudent glee at your failure! Oh ho, how I will laugh!
Mallika heads out to the sponsors' section of the parking lot with her film equipment.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Grr! Who does that guy think he is?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: When I show up with a great interview, he'll `have` to acknowledge me!
nodes.text_bbcode: When I show up with a great interview, he'll [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] to acknowledge me!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Too bad I don't really know what to interview the sponsors about...
Get Tom to confess! Don't feel sorry for him.
While the other skaters compete, Mallika waits with the film crew for the inspirational speech from the documentary director.

nodes.speaker: Lors Von Tripe
nodes.text: You philistines don't understand staging, narrative imagery, or even lighting! How could I ever trust any of you to interview the sponsors?

nodes.speaker: Lors Von Tripe
nodes.text: I bet none of you have even sneezed at a Dolex 16mm camera!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I have...

nodes.speaker: Lors Von Tripe
nodes.text: Who said that? Who thinks that he... Or she... Knows direction better than I?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I didn't imply that. It's just... We haven't even shown you what we know or don't know.

nodes.speaker: Lors Von Tripe
nodes.text: You think you understand the craft of film?

nodes.speaker: Lors Von Tripe
nodes.text: Do you know how to adjust an aperture? How to keep an appropriate pace? How to come up with a tag line?

nodes.speaker: Lors Von Tripe
nodes.text: Do you even know what these terms mean?!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Uh... Well... I...

rounds.subtitle: Get Tom to confess! Don't feel sorry for him.
Get Tom to confess! Don't feel sorry for him.

nodes.text: Mallika lines up the shot... Gets Tom and Silas in the frame...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Perfect! This shot is amazing!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I'll show Lars von Tripe a thing or two about film!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Now let's see what's going on in there...
Spike builds up momentum...
Doing easy ollies while he builds up speed...
He rides up the vert...
And kicks off!
He completes his Inverted Air Slug with a triple flip!
And lands perfectly!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Yes! A perfect 1080! I rule!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I finally pulled off the Inverted Air Slug!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: No matter what happens, I can at least say I've never skated better!

nodes.speaker: Judge
nodes.text: And the winner is... Skazz Von Tooten!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Aw, man...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Yes! I'm the best! I'm number one!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: In your face, Spike! IN... YOUR... `FACE!`
nodes.text_bbcode: In your face, Spike! IN... YOUR... [color=#e23b3b][i]FACE![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Judge
nodes.text: And second place goes to... Spike Chapman! Come on up and collect your prize...

nodes.speaker: Judge
nodes.text: A date with Silas Prince!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: What?! Are you kidding me?! What sort of a terrible prize is that?

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: How dare you greet me like that, you urchin? I'm the richest man in the Crosstown Valley!

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Now then. About this 'date'...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Watch out, Spike! Silas is the guy that tried to...
Silas snaps his fingers. Out of nowhere, three security guards rush out, grab Mallika, and carry her off!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hey! You have your men let her go right now or I'll...

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chapman
nodes.text: Spike! Where are your manners? You can't talk to this nice gentleman that way!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Mom?!

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chapman
nodes.text: Now then... Mr. Prince, I know I could use a date!

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Why, hello there, ma'am!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Mom! You have to be joking! And I thought you had a job interview today!

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chapman
nodes.text: Who needs a job when you can have a date with the richest... And handsomest... Man in town!

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Now then, ahem, ahem... What is your name, you ravishing creature?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: This isn't happening... This isn't happening...

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chapman
nodes.text: Quiet, Spike! You don't want to scare off your future stepfather, do you?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Aaaaaaaaaaagh!
That's a terrible idea! You can't let Spike's mom date Tom's dad!
That would make Spike and Tom step-brothers! And that's absolutely the last thing anyone would ever want!
Why don't you go back and try this episode again? If you try a little harder as Spike, we're sure you can get him a better ending!
Or try playing the new Mega Pack: Homecoming Queen!
It's a battle for the crown between the most popular girls at Centerscore High! Do you have what it takes to beat Paula and become the new Homecoming Queen? Play now to find out!

args.text: Try again! You can do it!

nodes.prompt: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.text: Spike builds up some speed...
Hops on a rail...
He rides it goofy all the way down...
Gets ready for the flip...
And finishes it!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Well, it wasn't the best... But at least the crowd still likes the trick!
He rides down... Aims for the grind rail...
But slips and falls down!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Shoot! There's no way I can recover points from that!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Look, I know we've had our disagreements... And I know we might not get along... But right now, you're messing with something far more dangerous than you can imagine.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Just give me the camera, and it'll all be okay...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: This is the kind of footage amateur filmmakers dream their whole lives of getting... Footage that would blow away Lors and probably make me famous...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: But the FLEX-Games mean so much to Spike... And I can't let Tom Prince take that away from him!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You want the footage, Tom? Then you can have it!
Mallika winds up and tosses the camera right into Tom's face!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Aaaaaaagh! Ow! My face! My beautiful face!
Tom stumbles back, and Mallika takes off running towards the skate park!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: No! Get back here!

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Forget it, boy! We've got the footage... Let's just get out of here before our name gets sullied any further!
Meanwhile, Spike stands at the Starting Deck for the Street Event...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Oh man, I am so nervous...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: The judges gave Skazz a 91! That's going to be nearly impossible to beat!
Spike kneels down... Puts one foot on the fancy blue skateboard...
When suddenly, he hears a voice calling to him from the far side of the skate park!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Your lucky board, Spike! You've got to use your lucky board!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: That's... That's Mallika!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: This isn't going to make those corporate guys happy... But I trust her. If she says 'use the lucky board', I'm using my lucky board!
Spike tosses aside the blue skateboard... And it shatters against the wall!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: What the... It must have been a trap! Mallika was warning me!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I'll have to make sure to thank her later... But right now, I've got a skate tournament to win!
Spike jumps on his old board and drops in!
Mallika lines up the shot... Leans forward...
Leans forward...
And scratches the lens of the camera on the window frame!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Oops! Lors von Tripe is going to kill me! The image is all blurry now!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I guess I'll have to just settle for recording audio... Now let's see what's going on!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Well, I'm glad you're looking out for me, really, but you don't have to worry. I'd sooner kiss Skazz!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: The way things are going, you're going to have to get in line... If he wins the Flex-Games, there's not going to be any shortage of girls trying to make out with him!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Come on, Spike. I don't care how much of Tom's money or equipment Skazz has. He is `not` going to beat you.
nodes.text_bbcode: Come on, Spike. I don't care how much of Tom's money or equipment Skazz has. He is [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] going to beat you.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You... You mean that?
Mallika steps forward to take Spike's hand.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I do.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Well, then I... I...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hey! Look! Over there!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: What? Huh?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: That man! You see that guy right there?
Mallika sees a very well-dressed man with a serious look on his face!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: That's Silas Prince, Tom's father! You know, Silas Prince? CEO of Prince Automotive? He practically owns Centerscore!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: What's he doing here? There's no way a big-shot like him would be involved in something like this!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: It looks like he's heading into Tom's trailer... And he looks mad!

nodes.speaker: Loudspeaker
nodes.text: Next up, on the Street Course... Skazz von Tooten!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Listen, I need to get out there. Skazz is up next, and I'm after him!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Don't worry, Spike. I'll go see what Tom and his dad are up to!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You're the best!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Good luck! See you on the course!
Mallika sneaks along towards the trailer...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Huh... It sounds like shouting! I bet this has to do with the sponsorship!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: If I can get this on film, it'll be riveting! Lors Von Tripe will have no choice but to use it!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Let's see if I can just position the camera by this window...
Mallika kneels down and crouches under the window...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Okay, I've got a clear shot of the two of them... Now I just need to set up the camera and start rolling...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Focus, Mallika, focus! Don't get distracted! Make this shot count!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: What are you talking about? How is it different?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Well, I... I think he's got a crush on me.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: What?! Still?! You threw him in the ocean!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Weirdly enough, I think he's got a crush on me `because` I threw him in the ocean.
nodes.text_bbcode: Weirdly enough, I think he's got a crush on me [color=#3b78e2][i]because[/i][/color] I threw him in the ocean.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: So he's trying to mess me up to get with you... And you think that makes it better?!
Spike angrily kicks a car!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Ow!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Spike! Calm down! You need to focus on winning these games!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Sorry, sorry... But the thought of Tom Prince making a move on you just makes me sick!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: He did seem pretty serious about not breaking any rules... But I guess some people just can't be trusted!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Exactly! You won't believe how many girls I saw that guy lie to when I was a waiter at The Oceanside Obelisk.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I'm glad you're so perceptive, Mallika.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Heh, thanks!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Although I could probably stand to be a little bit more perceptive... I should've realized a long time ago that Tom was still crushing on me!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: What? He is? Seriously?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I think he sees me as a challenge or something. It's horrible.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: He'd better see it as a challenge... Because the only way Tom's making a move on you is over my dead body!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Not as well as I'd like. I'm totally off my game.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Oh... I'm sorry.
After the 'interview', Mallika heads back to the arena and runs into Spike...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Hey, Spike. How are the FLEX-Games going?
Hold the camera...
Hold the camera...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Wow... What sort of sponsor has a stretch-limo trailer?
Mallika knocks on the door of the stretch-trailer.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Come in! I'm ready for my interview!
Mallika steps into the trailer...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'm a sponsor! I have every right to be here!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You're a sponsor? I'm supposed to be interviewing you?!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You don't know anything about skateboarding!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You don't need knowledge to be a sponsor, Mallika... All you need is money!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Ugh, you know what? I don't even care about the documentary. I'm out of here.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: `Wait!` Now that you're here... Maybe we ought to do this interview after all!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Wait![/i][/color] Now that you're here... Maybe we ought to do this interview after all!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Today's events are going to be that much more satisfying if I get to lord them over you!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I have no idea what you're talking about, but why I would possibly even begin to humor this?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Because if you don't, you'll never know why I decided to sponsor the sure-fire winner of this little tourney... Skazz!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Skazz? You're sponsoring Skazz? Why?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ah-ah-ah... I only talk about my business choices in professional interviews!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Grr... How do I handle this?

nodes.prompt: Grr... How do I handle this?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Grr... How do I handle this?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Oh my gosh... That's it, isn't it? You're still into me, and you're... You're jealous!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What? No! That's ridiculous! That's preposterous!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: That's totally what this is! This is some creepy 'I'm the only girl who's ever rejected you, and now you're obsessed with me' thing! Ewwwwww!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: How dare you?! You should be `honored` by my attraction!
nodes.text_bbcode: How dare you?! You should be [color=#e23b3b][i]honored[/i][/color] by my attraction!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: So you are attracted! You just admitted it!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: No! I... I mean... That is to say, I...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Get out! Get out now! The interview is over!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You couldn't keep me here if you wanted to!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Arrrggggh! That does it!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You doing okay, Mallika? You look a little rattled.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Listen, Spike, I just ran into Tom Prince...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Tom Prince?! He's here?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: He's sponsoring Skazz. That's why he's so good now.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: That jerk!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I wouldn't mind if Skazz beat me on his own...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: But I can't believe that he would cheat and get Prince's help.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: He isn't cheating. Tom's done everything a good sponsor would do.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You're defending him?!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: No, I'm saying he didn't do anything `illegal.` Gross, lame, and immoral, sure...
nodes.text_bbcode: No, I'm saying he didn't do anything [color=#3b78e2][i]illegal.[/i][/color] Gross, lame, and immoral, sure...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Trust me on this one. Tom Prince will do `anything` to win, and that means he's going to break the rules... I promise you.
nodes.text_bbcode: Trust me on this one. Tom Prince will do [color=#e23b3b][i]anything[/i][/color] to win, and that means he's going to break the rules... I promise you.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Well...
In the trailer...

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: What were you thinking, boy? Did you honestly think I wouldn't notice?

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: I monitor every miserable penny in your bank account, you pathetic, little worm! I knew you were financing some peon in an idiotic athletic contest...

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: But I had assumed you were trying to make a tidy profit on some gambling!

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Imagine my shock when I turned on the television and discovered that Prince Automotive was sponsoring an athlete in the... What is it? FLEX-Games?!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You don't understand, father! I'm doing this to avenge my honor! I thought you'd be proud!

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Proud? Proud?!
Silas lunges forward and grabs Tom by the shirt!

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Duels of honor are fought in hazy alleys and dark, dusky rooms... Not out in public and not with the Prince family name!

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: The Prince name stands for quality, for reliability, for unbeatable strength!

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: What happens if your boy Skazz loses in these games, son? What happens if the Prince name is associated with being... A loser?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I... I... I'm sorry, father. I didn't think.
Silas exhales deeply, then lets Tom go.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: I... I understand. All boys make mistakes. I know I made mine.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But the FLEX-Games... Skazz... The family name...

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Oh, don't worry, boy. Watch and take note. I've taken care of the situation.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You... You have?

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: I've had one of my best mechanics go backstage, disguised as a maintenance man.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: When Skazz's rival, this Spike fellow, goes up... Well, let's just say he'll discover a few strategic cracks in that fancy blue skateboard of his!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Gasp!

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: What was that? Did you hear that?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: It sounded like a gasp!
Tom looks out the window... And sees Mallika running away!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: It's Mallika... And she's got a camera! She was taping our conversation!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: ...She really is something...

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Get her, boy! That footage could ruin me!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Oh no, oh no, oh no...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I've got to warn Spike! I've got to...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Oof!
Mallika falls on the ground, shattering the camera!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Oh no! The footage!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, now. That's not very good interview technique at all!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Get away from me, Tom! I heard you and your father! You're... You're monsters!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Monsters? That's awfully harsh. I prefer... 'Winners'.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: There's no way you'll win this! Spike's too smart to fall for your trick!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Oh really? Maybe you should listen a little more closely to the loudspeakers...

nodes.speaker: Loudspeaker
nodes.text: And the winner of the FLEX-Games is... Skazz Von Tooten!

nodes.speaker: Loudspeaker
nodes.text: No word yet on runner-up Spike Chapman, who was rushed to the hospital after breaking his leg in a bad fall...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Oh no!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You see, Mallika, you just can't win. There's no beating the Prince family.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: We run the cops. We run the schools. We run the businesses. We run every single last inch of Centerscore.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: So you can either give in and do what we say... Or you can keep fighting us until we utterly destroy you.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Now what do you say? How about another date?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Never!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Your call.
Forty-eight hours later, at the 'Sketchy Pines Boot Camp For Troubled Girls'...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Well, this sucks.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Less talking and more gathering, missy! That litter isn't going to pick up itself!
Mallika in boot camp, Spike in the hospital, and Tom Prince feeling good about himself? No way that's the good ending!
Try again, and this time, play a little more carefully as Mallika... You might just be able to warn Spike before it's too late!
Or try playing the new Mega Pack: Homecoming Queen!
It's a battle for the crown between the most popular girls at Centerscore High! Do you have what it takes to beat Paula and become the new Homecoming Queen? Play now to find out!

args.text: Try again! You can do it!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Stop right there, Mallika!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Get away from me, you monster!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Now all I can do is wait and see what the judges think...
In their panel, the judges deliberate... Deliberate...
While the other skaters compete, Mallika waits with the film crew for the inspirational speech from the documentary director.

nodes.speaker: Lors Von Tripe
nodes.text: You philistines don't understand staging, narrative imagery, or even lighting! How could I ever trust any of you to interview the sponsors?

nodes.speaker: Lors Von Tripe
nodes.text: I bet none of you have even sneezed at a Dolex 16mm camera!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I have...

nodes.speaker: Lors Von Tripe
nodes.text: Who said that? Who thinks that he... Or she... Knows direction better than I?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I didn't imply that. It's just... We haven't even shown you what we know or don't know.

nodes.speaker: Lors Von Tripe
nodes.text: You think you understand the craft of film?

nodes.speaker: Lors Von Tripe
nodes.text: Do you know how to adjust an aperture? How to keep an appropriate pace? How to come up with a tag line?

nodes.speaker: Lors Von Tripe
nodes.text: Do you even know what these terms mean?!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Uh... Well... I...

rounds.subtitle: Get Tom to confess! Don't feel sorry for him.
Get Tom to confess! Don't feel sorry for him.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Stop right there, Mallika!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Get away from me, you monster!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: All right. I might have a chance at winning.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Um... That's great.
If this were the FLEX-Games, we'd give you a score of, oh, say, 91...
Good... Real good... But not perfect! Try again! We know you can get it!

nodes.speaker: Judge
nodes.text: And the winner is...

nodes.speaker: Judge
nodes.text: Spike Chapman!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: It's me? I did it?! I won?!

nodes.speaker: Judge
nodes.text: Congratulations! Come on up and collect your prize money!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Oh, I will... But there's something I've got to do first!
Spike races across the skate park to the parking lot...
Where Mallika is waiting!
Mallika lunges forward and grabs Spike in a close hug!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Oh my gosh, Spike, I'm so glad you're okay! Tom's dad was here, and it turns out he's way evil, and he was going to sabotage your board...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: So I taped them talking, but then I gasped, so they started chasing me, and then I threw the footage away, but I warned you in time, and you won, and... And... And...
Spike steps forward and kisses Mallika!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: S... Spike?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Look, I don't really understand what happened here today, but I know you were there for me when I needed you most.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: If I'd ridden that sponsored board, I would have definitely lost... Or worse!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I won the FLEX-Games, Mallika... But you know what? All I could think about was how badly I wanted to share that moment with you!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Oh, Spike... I'm so happy!
Mallika steps forward into Spike's arms.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: So does that mean you're ready to start thinking about dating again?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Dating? No. But I am ready to start thinking about you!
And so, a few hours later... Spike and Mallika lie cuddling together on the Centerscore half-pipe, watching the sun set!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I wish you could've heard Chip when I called and told him I'd won... He screamed so loudly I'm pretty sure the neighbors called the cops!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You're such a good big brother, Spike. And your mom will really appreciate you winning that prize money.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Yeah... Although I can probably kiss the corporate sponsorship goodbye, seeing as how it looks like I shattered their board on purpose...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Hey, you think that's bad? What do you think Lars von Tripe is going to do when he realizes I lost his camera? I'll be lucky if I ever get a film gig again!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Guess we both lost something today, huh?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Yeah... But I think we both gained something even better!
Mallika leans over and kisses Spike.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Listen... If Tom Prince ever tries anything again... `Anything`... I'll be there for you, you understand?
nodes.text_bbcode: Listen... If Tom Prince ever tries anything again... [color=#e23b3b][i]Anything[/i][/color]... I'll be there for you, you understand?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: And I'll be here for you, Spike. Always.
Well! You won the FLEX-Games, defeated Tom Prince, and got Mallika together with Spike! Pretty darn impressive!
Of course, things might be good now... But you know it's never that simple at Centerscore!
Now that you've beaten this episode, don't forget to play the new Megapack: Homecoming Queen!

nodes.text: If this were the FLEX-Games, you'd have a score of 100... Because you just played a perfect game!
Enjoy your bonus scene! You earned it!
That night, in the CEO's office of Prince Automotive...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'm back, father.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: And? The tape?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Destroyed. There's no evidence of our wrong-doing.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: What about this urchin you sponsored... Skazz?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: He had a total melt-down after losing to Spike. It must have been all of those energy drinks!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: He was raving, screaming, throwing things... It took four security guards just to take him down!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: He'll be lucky if anyone believes a word he ever says.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Good. Well done, boy.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: So, am I forgiven?

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Forgiven? Forgiven?! The Prince name was still slandered today, boy... When it was associated with a certified loser!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But Skazz skated really well! And besides, who even watches the FLEX-Games?

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: So it seems you still have not fully learned your lesson. Well, perhaps you will contemplate it... While you're fending for yourself!

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Your credit cards are revoked for one month!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What? You can't do that! How am I supposed to pay for restaurants or night-clubs? How am I supposed to impress girls?!

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Perhaps I've coddled you too much, boy. Perhaps I've been too giving.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Maybe one month of hard living is exactly what you need!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Spike... Mallika... You'll pay for this!
Well, that can't be good... But on the bright side, maybe a month of eating fast-food will give Tom some perspective!
See you in another episode!
